target_customer: Meat producers wanting to upgrade low value minced meat into whole cuts, plus foodservice and direct to consumer buyers of plant-based steaks
problem: Plant-based and cultivated meat lacked authentic whole cut texture. Offbeast adds fibrous whole muscle texture to plant and animal proteins to raise producer margins.
business_model: B2B technology and ingredient partnerships with some direct sales of plant-based steaks
product_category: food tech, whole cut meat alternatives

founders.name: Insa Mohr
education: Master's in information technology, Harvard University (per 3DPrint.com)
founders.background_notes: Interview says she worked in biopharma and management consulting; employers not named.

founders.name: Jochen Mueller
founders.background_notes: Named as a founder by 3DPrint.com (May 2022); not listed on the YC page.

competitors.name: Redefine Meat
competitors.traction_then: commercial launch of whole cuts in late 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Creating aligned fibre whole cut texture with a plant based binder on standard food lines needed food science and process engineering, starting from 3D printing research at Harvard.

defensibility.rationale: Process know how and patents may protect it, but several funded rivals pursued whole cuts and the company changed approach once.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; the company moved from plant-only products to a beef and plant hybrid in 2026 per vegconomist.

market_need_then: Whole cut texture was the unsolved gap in plant-based meat in 2022, noted in several trade pieces on whole cut competitors.

brand_strength.rationale: Trade press covers the company, but the name changed after the first coverage and no source shows community or brand effects.

pivots.from: plant-based whole cut steaks (Mooji Meats ribeye)
pivots.to: 50:50 beef and plant hybrid whole cuts sold through meat producer partners
pivots.why: Per vegconomist, to partner with meat producers; the article date is August 2026.

outcome_analysis: Offbeast, previously Mooji Meats, raised a $3M seed in May 2022 and developed whole cut texture technology. Plant-based demand weakened after 2022 and the company shifted toward hybrid beef products with meat producers, with a further reported investment from Global Brain. It is active and small.
notes: Seed amount also reported by TechCrunch (May 2022, headline and snippet) and Green Queen (shown in pounds). PitchBook and others report $4.5M to $6.5M totals and a $1M Global Brain round in 2025; unverified and not recorded. Conflicting location (New York per YC, Baltimore per press). The rebrand date is inferred as after the seed coverage; exact date unknown. The YC page lists only Insa Mohr. 'Growth' stage label in the directory is not supported by sources. Rebrand from Mooji Meats to Offbeast is sourced (vegconomist, Brighter Future interview) but its date and reason are not stated, so no dated rebrand entry is recorded.
